summary: Return typed retryable API refusal on real ticket-store lock contention

delivery.outcome: Fix semcod/planfile#299 by translating pre-commit StoreLockTimeoutError contention into a sanitized, typed retryable HTTP 503 response with Retry-After while preserving writer ownership, ticket state, CAS preconditions, and evidence idempotency.
nonGoals: Do not delete locks, interrupt active writer processes, or alter lock timeout thresholds.
Do not silently replay non-idempotent ticket creation, claim, or update mutations.
Do not duplicate disposable-index contention changes from ticket-243.

architecture.decision: Register a FastAPI StoreLockTimeoutError exception handler returning HTTP 503 with Retry-After and sanitized typed JSON, propagate StoreLockTimeoutError from DSL/YAML API endpoints, and verify with real separate-process flock contention tests.

components.name: FastAPI store-lock contention handling and regression tests

interfaceChanges: HTTP 503 ticket_store_lock_timeout response with Retry-After header on pre-commit store-lock contention
architecture.rollback: Revert the FastAPI StoreLockTimeoutError handler and associated tests through governed publication.

validation.evidence: Real separate-process lock contention across API mutation endpoints returns bounded HTTP 503 with Retry-After: 5 and sanitized JSON without host paths or PIDs.
Lock inode, holder process, ticket state, execution.attempt, sprint YAML, and evidence journals remain unchanged during contention.
Subsequent operations, CAS/terminal/idempotency guards, and unexpected HTTP 500 error propagation work normally after lock release.
